description: List every open item for a property: DOB jobs with a permit issued but no sign-off, active DOB violations (the BIS list and DOB NOW safety violations), active ECB violations, open HPD violations, and OATH tickets with an unpaid balance or a pending hearing. Each record has status, dates, a plain-English description and its source dataset. Requires one of "address", "bbl" or "bin".

address.description: NYC street address, e.g. "98 Grattan St, Brooklyn". Units (Apt 3B), borough and ZIP are optional; a 10-digit BBL or 7-digit BIN also works.

bbl.description: 10-digit BBL (borough-block-lot), e.g. "3030090016". Send it as text.

bin.description: 7-digit DOB building number (BIN), e.g. "3070696". Send it as text.

borough.description: Optional: Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens or Staten Island

name: list_open_issues
title: List open violations, open DOB jobs and unpaid tickets
